versions.changelog: R20 upgrade 0.3.0: align judgment, evidence and trust boundaries; regression fixes and release checks. Validation limits and remaining issues are documented in the bundled CHANGELOG.md.

First hub release. Pure-local memoized workspace backup to a fixed folder AND an external drive: inventory -> classify -> route -> copy -> verify, incremental with resume. Never deletes from source; three hard safety lines enforced by exit codes (Time Machine volume refusal, guard-approved destinations only, no SAFE verdict without real observation). Two adversarial battery rounds + a real 36 GB run behind it.
